criteria.statement: A shared worker admission service exposes typed scope, request, and decision structures and ordered common admission checks.
worker_policy.go, ml_placement.go, llm_placement.go, and backup_placement.go delegate common worker admission checks to the service.
LLM worker-backed placement enforces scheduling state and external_api placement uses an explicit workerless admission bypass reason.
Telemetry-missing workers are reduced and allowed for non-dynamic placements but rejected when dynamic headroom is requested.
ML and LLM dynamic GB minima are converted to byte-level admission headroom checks before family-specific scoring.
